prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE SQUARE 2x2 atlas with four equal square cells for an adult vocabulary app. Attached image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: restrained ink-and-watercolor educational illustrations, clear dark blue-charcoal outlines, pale blue wash, small warm natural color accents. Pure WHITE opaque background. Central 75% of each quadrant contains its subject with generous margins. Nothing crosses midlines. Leave horizontal 45–55% and vertical 47–53% center bands EMPTY WHITE. Natural human anatomy, recognizable objects, clear 320px silhouettes, restrained detail, no elaborate environment. NO captions, labels, writing, borders, grid lines, watermarks or logos. Only symbols or numerals explicitly requested in a cell are allowed. Meanings are guidance; never write them. Row-major fixed order. FOUR CELLS:
TOP LEFT — anticipate (v.预期，预料): An adult sets the table for a guest while glancing expectantly toward the door, preparing for an expected arrival.
TOP RIGHT — philosopher (n.哲学家): A thoughtful scholar sits with several open books and a hand on chin, contemplating ideas rather than conducting an experiment.
BOTTOM LEFT — wisdom (n.智慧): An older adult calmly guides a younger person to choose a safe bridge instead of a dangerous broken crossing, thoughtful sound judgement.
BOTTOM RIGHT — spiritual (a.精神上的): An adult sits quietly in reflective meditation beside a candle, calm inner life, respectful and nonsectarian.
CROP SAFETY: each scene has 20% white margins inside its own quadrant. Bottom-row heads, hair, thought bubbles and main objects begin BELOW 58% total image height. Nothing crosses midlines.
review_notes: Reviewed all four scenes for intended meaning, intact anatomy, and safe white margins within each quadrant.
